note: People walking around 云海 (src/world/crowd.js). `count` people in `colors` walk between spots on the flat ground inside `areas` ([x0, z0, x1, z1], city-local metres from the master layout: downtown and the promenade), wherever the collision registry leaves room, joined to the metro spawn. They stop, sit on anything the city marks as a bench (`seatHeight`), and look out over the bay from anywhere north of `bay.z`, facing `bay.yaw`. Ground the city marks as `keepOff` (a road) is left alone except where it is also marked `crossAt`. Looking at one names them (objects.json `pedestrian`); E has them say `lines[n]`, voiced as its audio id in its speaker's cast voice by scripts/generate-voice.py.
